description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/edit-provenance.ts, stop the provenance guard from reporting a replacement's own newly declared locals as unknown symbols.

Insert this single line immediately BEFORE the line that reads exactly:
    if (AMBIENT.has(receiver)) continue;

Insert exactly this line:
    if (replacement.includes("const " + receiver) || replacement.includes("let " + receiver) || replacement.includes("var " + receiver) || replacement.includes("function " + receiver) || replacement.includes("class " + receiver)) continue;

WHY: unknownMemberAccesses decides whether a member access in the replacement is grounded by testing the receiver against moduleText only. It never consults the replacement itself, so a self-contained inserted block that declares its own locals and then uses them is reported as introducing unknown symbols and the whole edit is refused with kind replacement_introduces_unknown_symbol. OBSERVED DIRECTLY 2026-09-12: an insertion that declared const repeatLessons and const repeatKeys three lines above their use was refused with the message replacement references repeatLessons.length, repeatKeys.size, absent from the target module. Both symbols were declared by the replacement itself. MEASURED SCOPE: 6 of 39 fc-anchor-provenance blind-edit refusals over 24 hours.

CORRECTNESS: the new check admits a receiver only when the replacement itself declares it with const, let, var, function or class. A replacement that references a genuinely undeclared symbol still falls through to the existing moduleText test and is still refused, so the guard keeps catching real fabrications. This was verified before the goal was written: the predicate returns true for a receiver the replacement declares and false for an undeclared one.

PLACEMENT: the line goes immediately before the AMBIENT check so that a locally declared receiver short-circuits before the moduleText test below it. The anchor line occurs exactly once in the file.

Do not change any other line in the file. Do not reformat surrounding code.

POST-CONDITION: after this change the file contains the exact string replacement.includes("const " + receiver), the AMBIENT check is still present immediately after the inserted line, and the file typechecks clean.
